non_overlapping_accounting.identity: Only the residual-add prologue before the already-fused RMSNorm+quant boundary is credited. Gate-up GEMM, its dispatcher, all other linears, attention/KV, tied head, prefill, and scheduler time remain unchanged.

m32_dispatch_overlap.reason: This intervention changes neither scaled-MM inputs, tile selection, weight bytes, GEMM output, nor cutlass_gemm_sm100_fp8_dispatch.

non_overlapping_accounting.upper_interval_reason: If the residual add is a separate kernel, the fused candidate removes one reread of the BF16 residual_out tensor and one launch; residual_out itself must still be written because the post-MLP residual consumer needs it.
non_overlapping_accounting.zero_lower_bound_reason: The retained endpoint did not preserve generated Inductor code or a kernel trace, so the residual add may already be folded into the compiler-generated RMSNorm+quant prologue.

source_trace.claim: The post-attention output is RMS-normalized, added to the pre-attention residual, copied to residual, then pre-feedforward RMS-normalized and passed to Gemma4MLP.
Every dense decoder layer sends the pre-feedforward RMSNorm output into one runtime-dynamic-FP8 gate_up projection with K=5376 and N=43008.
The producer emits per-token E4M3 activations and FP32 scales; the first decision-bearing consumer is BF16 Cutlass scaled-MM output.

At the launcher's default O2 Inductor configuration, custom ops are disabled and the pinned source explicitly delegates RMSNorm+FP8-quant fusion to Inductor. The custom fusion pass is enabled only when RMSNorm or quant_fp8 is forced to a custom op.
The same pinned extension already provides a residual-aware fused RMSNorm+dynamic-per-token-quant primitive, so a new kernel would duplicate a supported mechanism.

typed_rejections.mechanism: new RMSNorm plus dynamic-FP8 quant kernel
typed_rejections.reason: Pinned O2 configuration disables custom RMSNorm/quant ops specifically because Inductor handles their fusion.

typed_rejections.mechanism: fold post-MLP RMSNorm into down-projection epilogue
typed_rejections.reason: RMSNorm needs a complete 5376-wide row reduction while the scaled-MM owns independent output tiles, and the normalized output participates in a residual add. A CUTLASS tile epilogue cannot preserve this contract without a cross-tile reduction or another stage.

whole_request_relevance.interpretation: Even a generous 10-us launch sensitivity addresses only about 5% of the remaining target gap. This is stackable work, not a primary route.
